review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD. REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 preserve Error identity, string-wrapper compatibility, and the existing retry-abort contract. The source evidence supports index.js and the directly maintained index.d.ts as implementation owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts as regression owners; the exact four-file writable scope does not require unnecessary edits. package.json establishes the separate runtime and type-checking entry points through xo && ava && tsd. The stable requirement, acceptance, and task keys agree across the specification and Gold; the original task expectations also require independent verification dependent on implementation and coverage of every required AC. Ready status with no blocking reasons is appropriate: this PRD contains no unresolved material Decision, and the change concerns invocation-local error construction rather than shared data or state. The designated implementer and verifier have the relevant supplied active project-scoped trusted claims, including testing.verification for the verifier; eligibility need not rely on Persona, pending claims, or untrusted capability summaries. A separate active reviewer is configured. Repository identity and revision, release-input fingerprints, model configuration, policy version, and budgets agree between Gold and the frozen preview. The supplied provenance explains the distinct source-digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. Historical operations are explicitly retained as old-version observations, not fresh candidates for this bundle. I relied on the supplied Service binding and provenance assertions; I did not independently recompute digests, execute code, or provide human attestation. No material error or unresolved ambiguity was identified.
